description: EcoPack Limited has manufactured PET preforms and bottles since 1993 and describes itself as one of Pakistan's leading manufacturers of them. Its plant is in Hattar Industrial Estate, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, with offices in Rawalpindi, Lahore and Karachi, and it uses European and Canadian machinery to make bottles and preforms from 240 ml to 12 litres. It says it is a premier vendor of beverage and edible-oil packaging to multinational and national companies in Pakistan and abroad, and holds ISO certifications.
